summary: Stabilize wheel fixtures that gate publication

delivery.outcome: Make hashed wheel fixtures independent of wall-clock time so the existing strict race/integrity regression reliably validates and releases the accepted Goal 2.2.7 source.
nonGoals: No production observer or publisher logic changes
No suppressed test, weakened integrity assertion or review bypass

architecture.decision: Construct the existing wheel test archive with explicit constant ZIP entry timestamps. Add a deterministic clock-change regression which fails with the original generator. Keep the strict commit-race reason and all archive integrity checks. This resolves the qualified publication-blocking fixture defect recorded by the existing diagnostic owner incident; the accepted 2.2.7 release remains pending its first upload.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of the exact test fixture correction; retain published immutable versions.

commands: Clock-change regression fails with the original generator and passes after timestamp correction
Original strict race and integrity tests remain unchanged
Affected Testless and actual Goal workflow
Goal -a publish-only on the clean accepted canonical checkout
Verify both registry artifacts and installed canaries
